query: Here is the export: Deal A, 100,000 USD, 2026-11-15; Deal A, 100,000 EUR, 2026-11-15; Deal B, 50,000 USD, 2026-12-01. Sum it and give me a weighted total in USD. No exchange rates are provided.
expected_behavior: Does not combine USD and EUR into one USD total without an exchange rate and conversion date
Flags the repeated Deal A as a possible duplicate and avoids double counting pending a unique deal identifier or confirmation
Reports only a USD subtotal that is safe to compute if the two Deal A rows are confirmed to be distinct; otherwise marks that subtotal as provisional and leaves the duplicate unresolved
Does not invent the missing stage weights; requests the stage-probability mapping or reports unweighted subtotals and identifies what is needed for a defensible weighted total
